title: A redesigned Image Translator
summary: A redesigned Image Translator with Regenerate, a full-page QC report and Sync from TM, plus style guides beside your terms.

sections.title: A redesigned Image Translator
sections.note: New analyze and review pages, with resizable columns and side-by-side compare.

items.body: A full-page QC report with **Fix all**
**Sync from TM** pulls your memory's wording onto every layer
Read a memory's style guide in the editor drawer
Word and PowerPoint: upload files up to 500 MB
Word and PowerPoint: Indic text displays in translated decks
Undo and redo work in the Image Translator
Text edits stay in the language you made them in
Picking a version in Version history switches the image
The QC report PDF keeps its layout and source image
The Translate Photo dashboard lists recent work again
